how.measured: seen or measured on that class of client with this probe's window (the probes were rewritten to need only nw_inc_nui.nss and to pick the player generically; `changed` says what else changed)
how.from_rules: follows from the rules cited (for android: T69, Android lays out as the desktop); not run with this probe

classes.desktop: Linux x64 and an Intel Mac, GUI scale 1.0
classes.ios_d3: iOS on an iPhone, density 3, GUI scale 1.0 unless the result says

probes.name: prb_device
probes.isolates: build, platform, GUI size and scale of every player

desktop.result: platform by OS: 11 Linux x64, 21 Intel Mac; gui_scale as set

probes.name: prb_devkeys
probes.isolates: guessed GetPlayerDeviceProperty keys for touch, density, controller

probes.name: prb_clamp
probes.isolates: the density probe: a window bound to x = y = 20000, clamped and reported back

desktop.result: report within about 3 s; d = s

ios_d3.result: report within about 3 s; d = 3.0 at s 1.0 and 1.6

probes.name: prb_margin
probes.isolates: a 32-high label (28 in c5) in fixed rows of 36 to 48, margin default, 0, 2, 3, 4

ios_d3.result: c3, c4, c6 build; c1, c2, d1, d2, d3 refused (measured); c5, d4 refused (from the rule)

probes.name: prb_rowh

desktop.result: rows h px at s 1.0, pitch h + 4

ios_d3.result: rows 59.5 px (20) and 119 px (40); pitch about 3 h + 12

probes.changed: window positions divided by f; the row fill clipped to the cell

probes.name: prb_cells
probes.isolates: a row template of fixed cells 40, 100, 40 in a list 300 wide

ios_d3.result: first cell about 128 px; no gaps; the rest cut by the list's edge

probes.name: prb_mincell
probes.isolates: template cells 2, 266, 2 divided by f, rows 34 / f

ios_d3.result: blue and red cells about 11 px (11.4)

probes.changed: widths divided by f instead of a fixed 3 (the same on the iPhone at s 1.0)

probes.name: prb_draw
probes.isolates: draw-list rects 0..10 and 20..30 and a 100 x 60 outline, in a list cell and a plain element

desktop.result: green 10 px tall, red from 20 to 30, outline round the element

ios_d3.result: green about 28 px (27.9), red from about 60 to 90, outline 300 x 180 past the element; the same in the list and the plain element

probes.changed: second window's position divided by f

probes.name: prb_place
probes.isolates: a window at 100, 100 and one at -1, -1

desktop.result: left edge at 100 s px; the second centred

ios_d3.result: left edge about 304 px at s 1.0 and 1.6; the second clamped into the bottom-right corner

probes.name: prb_gap
probes.isolates: six 30 x 30 elements, margin 0, in a row and in a column

ios_d3.result: no gaps; each element 30 px at s 1.0

probes.changed: drawing 30 / f instead of a fixed 10

desktop.result: every label centred in its frame

ios_d3.result: frame inset about 10 px vertically; at 32 the label sits low past the frame; padding 0 no change, 2 squeezes the frame; at 36 centred

probes.name: prb_listins
probes.isolates: a bordered list with one 300-wide cell filled green, beside a plain 300 x 40 element

desktop.result: rows 4 inside the border on each side

ios_d3.result: about 14 at s 1.0, about 8.7 at s 1.6

probes.name: prb_frame
probes.isolates: a two-row window (content 360 x 72, margin 0) at the desktop frame + an extra width (axis w) or height (axis h)

desktop.result: every window fits; the desktop frame (extra 0) fits

ios_d3.result: no horizontal scrollbar from +32 (s 1.0), +12 (s 1.6); height first fits at +48 (s 1.0), +16 (s 1.6); even gaps at about +66, +28

probes.changed: the layout re-created with nw_inc_nui only; the measurements were taken on the same layout in a module's window

probes.name: prb_image
probes.isolates: base-game images: three TGA-only names, a TGA+DDS name, a PNG, a JPG, a GIF, a draw-list image of a TGA-only name

ios_d3.result: the TGA-only names (NuiImage and drawn) black boxes of the right size; TGA+DDS, PNG, JPG, GIF draw, the GIF animates

probes.changed: the measured cells regrouped into one window
